about: Public-notice channels per operator or agency: pages, sites, feeds, lists and accounts through which the public is told of sewage discharges, by law, permit or voluntarily. Read by pipeline/ingest/notification_pages.py (schema and validator there; test tests/test_notice_channels.py).

channels.name: Amentum Services, Inc. (Hawthorne Army Depot)
channels.legal_basis: NPDES permit NV0021946 (NDEP): the 24-hour and five-day noncompliance reports of 40 CFR 122.41(l)(6), to NDEP
channels.note: Amentum Services, Inc. (Hawthorne Army Depot) reports a sewage discharge to NDEP: its permit's noncompliance reports (NRS 445A.467 binds local governments, not private holders). NDEP publishes no list of them; no public notice is required: no web channel found. The permit itself was not read: the federal standard condition is assumed.

channels.name: Nevada harmful algal bloom dashboard (Power BI)
channels.note: The only statewide bloom status found, shown in a Power BI report: the page returned only its script shell on 2026-11-09, in which no rows, no download and no data address were found (the report's own data calls were not examined). Not read; a supported export is an owner request. Blooms, not sewage.

channels.name: Nevada harmful algal bloom weekly e-mail update
channels.note: NDEP's weekly bloom update goes by e-mail to subscribers; no subscription was made. Blooms, not sewage.

channels.name: Nevada Division of Environmental Protection (harmful algal bloom program)
channels.link_text: the statewide HAB dashboard and the weekly e-mail list
channels.note: NDEP's bloom program page (read 2026-11-09 in the expansion research) links the statewide dashboard and the weekly e-mail update; watched for a new dashboard address or a data download. Blooms, not sewage.

channels.name: Nevada Division of Environmental Protection (public document search)
channels.note: NDEP's document search (https://ndep-onbase.nv.gov/) warns that not all record series are online; whether sewage incident files are searchable was not verified in the research. A records request for the NRS 445A.467 notices is an owner item.

channels.name: Nevada Division of Environmental Protection (sewage discharge notices under NRS 445A.467)
channels.legal_basis: NRS 445A.467(1)(a): a city, county, unincorporated town, general improvement district, wastewater district or water authority "that has been notified or is aware of the incident shall notify the Division electronically on the Internet website of the Division or by telephone"
channels.note: The notice goes to NDEP through its online intake (Nevada Environmental Activities, a reporting form and account login) or by telephone; no deadline is set, and NDEP passes it to an Indian tribe that may be affected. NDEP publishes no list of the notices and no public view of the intake was found: no web channel found. (https://www.leg.state.nv.us/NRS/NRS-445A.html#NRS445ASec467)

channels.name: Nevada Division of Environmental Protection (Water Quality Data Warehouse)
channels.note: Sampling results by station behind a search form (https://nevadawaterquality.ndep.nv.gov/MainPage.aspx); results and downloads were not exercised. Samples, not notices: a sample is never shown as a sewage report. Not verified in the research as a source of current results.

channels.agency: National Park Service, Lake Mead National Recreation Area
channels.name: National Park Service, Lake Mead (harmful algal blooms page)
channels.note: The park's bloom page: general advice, intermittent monitoring and public reports; its page date (November 2, 2026) is not the date of a new advisory. Watched without records for a dated alert. Lake Mead and Lake Mohave are shared with Arizona. Blooms, not sewage.

channels.name: Nevada Tahoe Conservation District (Nearshore Human Health monitoring)
channels.note: Lake Tahoe's nearshore bacteria monitoring (https://ntcd.org/nearshorehumanhealth/) is described with a 2023 report; its program page on Lake Tahoe Info gave no readable results (2026-11-09). No current station results or closures were found: no web channel found for current results.

channels.name: Southern Nevada Water Authority (Lower Colorado River watershed monitoring)
channels.note: SNWA describes its Lake Mead and Colorado River monitoring and offers its regional database by e-mail request (https://www.snwa.com/water-quality/watershed/index.html); no request was sent. Samples, not notices.

channels.name: Nevada Division of State Parks (HAB advisories)
channels.note: The parks' HAB Advisory page: the waters in state parks under a HAB Watch, Warning or Danger advisory, each with its update date (four Watch advisories in the Internet Archive's copy of 2026-08-13; the expansion research read Lahontan's November 2 downgrade to Warning and October 5 Watch notices for Rye Patch and Wild Horse). Blooms, not sewage. Voluntary. The feed is built but has no successful current read yet, and its health stays not ok until one succeeds.
